title: UCI campaign heldout predictions — retrospective duration comparison

transformation.description: All 13,216 heldout records, in their original published order; no filtering or selection. Only columns are renamed and anonymous source-row/block identifiers are formatted. Scores and binary outcomes retain their published numeric values.
transformation.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; comma delimiter; LF record endings for repository hygiene; header included.

models.a: Profile/history under stated timing assumptions; excludes duration
models.b: Same model specification plus post-call duration

notes: Real public-data derived scores, not a fabricated example.
Model B uses duration known only after the call; this sample is retrospective and cannot establish pre-call utility.
Groups are contiguous source month-label blocks, not inferred calendar dates or independent clients.
The source study used a fixed chronological split, no holdout tuning, and no causal allocation claims.
This CSV preserves the frozen study results; the reusable workbench does not retrain either model.

credit.citation: Moro, S., Cortez, P., and Rita, P. (2014). A Data-Driven Approach to Predict the Success of Bank Telemarketing. Decision Support Systems. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dss.2014.03.001
